skill.name: ralph-tui-create-beads-rust
skill.description: Convert a PRD into a beads-rust epic, child story beads, quality gates, and dependency links for ralph-tui execution.
skill.summary: Convert PRDs into beads-rust epics and child tasks for ralph-tui execution.
skill.author: subsy

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and fenced examples, not executable Ruby backtick usage. The real risk is the skill's actionable br command construction, where PRD-derived text is placed into shell command substitutions with a fixed heredoc delimiter. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed SKILL.md content.

remediation.issue: PRD text is inserted into shell command substitutions with a fixed EOF heredoc delimiter.
remediation.suggestion: Use a safer br input path such as a temporary file or API, or generate a unique delimiter and reject delimiter collisions before execution.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on local external commands that modify bead state and may start ralph-tui execution.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact commands and request user confirmation before running br or ralph-tui commands.

remediation.issue: Generated bead exports may contain private PRD details intended only for planning.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before committing .beads/issues.jsonl and keep local .beads database files out of version control.

static_findings.snippet: Converts PRDs to beads (epic + child tasks) for ralph-tui autonomous execution using **beads-rust**
> **Note:** This skill uses the `br` command from beads-rust. If you have the original beads (`bd`)
Take a PRD (markdown file or text) and create beads using `br` commands:
- **Universal gates:** Commands that apply to ALL stories (e.g., `pnpm typecheck`)
**If no Quality Gates section exists:** Ask the user what commands should pass, or use a sensible de
Beads use `br create` command with **HEREDOC syntax** to safely handle special characters:
> **CRITICAL:** Always use `<<'EOF'` (single-quoted) for the HEREDOC delimiter. This prevents shell
Use the `br dep add` command to specify which beads must complete first:
**Syntax:** `br dep add <issue> <depends-on>` — the issue depends on (is blocked by) depends-on.
- "Add `investorType` column to investor table with default 'cold'"
This exports the SQLite database to `.beads/issues.jsonl` for version control.
Beads are stored in: `.beads/` directory (SQLite DB + JSONL export)
- [ ] Dependencies added with `br dep add` after creating beads
- [ ] Ran `br sync --flush-only` to export for git tracking

semantic_findings.title: Heredoc Delimiter Injection Risk
semantic_findings.description: The skill places PRD-derived titles and descriptions inside fixed EOF heredocs that are wrapped in shell command substitution. A crafted PRD containing a standalone delimiter could break out of the intended description before br create runs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly takes PRD text and demonstrates command substitution with a fixed EOF delimiter. The risk depends on the agent executing those commands, so confidence is high but not absolute.

semantic_findings.title: Potential Version-Control Exposure of PRD Content
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs users to export bead data for git tracking after converting PRD stories into bead descriptions. Private product requirements can be exposed if the generated JSONL is committed to a shared repository.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The export and storage behavior is documented, and the bead descriptions come from PRD content. Exposure depends on repository sharing and commit practices, so this is a moderate-confidence contextual risk.

content.user_title: Convert PRDs Into Ralph TUI Beads
content.value_statement: Large PRDs are difficult to turn into executable ralph-tui work. This skill converts PRD stories into beads with dependencies and quality gates.
actual_capabilities: Extracts quality gates from PRDs and appends them to story acceptance criteria.
Creates an epic bead and child beads for user stories using br commands.
Splits large PRD features into smaller stories for one ralph-tui iteration.
Orders work by dependencies, from schema changes to backend and UI.
Adds dependency links with br dep add and syncs bead changes for tracking.
limitations: Requires beads-rust and the br CLI to be installed and initialized.
Depends on PRD quality, so vague stories may need user clarification.
Does not prove that generated implementation tasks are complete for every codebase.
Generated bead data may include sensitive PRD details if committed.

use_cases.title: Prepare PRD Execution
use_cases.description: Turn a product requirements document into ordered beads that ralph-tui can execute with clear acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Plan Agent-Sized Stories
use_cases.description: Break broad features into small implementation tasks that fit one autonomous coding iteration.

use_cases.title: Add Quality Gates
use_cases.description: Carry test, lint, typecheck, and browser verification requirements into each generated bead.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a PRD File
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner conversion from one PRD file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to convert ./tasks/billing-prd.md into beads-rust tasks. Preserve the PRD quality gates and show the planned dependency order first.

prompt_templates.title: Create Smaller Stories
prompt_templates.scenario: Split a large feature before creating beads.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this PRD and split any oversized user stories before creating beads. Keep each story small enough for one ralph-tui iteration.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Custom Gates
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this PRD into br beads. Add npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and browser verification to every relevant acceptance checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Build Dependency Chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a beads-rust epic from this PRD and make dependencies explicit. Order schema work first, backend work second, and UI work last.

output_examples.input: A PRD with one epic, three stories, and typecheck and lint gates.
output: Three child beads with acceptance criteria.
Dependencies from database work to backend work to UI work.

output_examples.input: A large dashboard PRD with broad user stories.
output: Smaller story beads for schema, queries, components, filters, and summary views.
Quality gates attached to every story.
Dependency links that prevent UI work before backend work.

output_examples.input: A PRD without a quality gates section.
output_examples.output: A clarification request for required validation commands, followed by a conservative default plan when the user approves.

best_practices: Review the PRD for sensitive details before generating beads.
Confirm quality gates before creating child tasks.
Inspect generated dependency order before running ralph-tui.
anti_patterns: Do not convert vague acceptance criteria without clarification.
Do not create one bead for a full multi-area feature.
Do not run generated shell commands without reviewing embedded PRD text.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a beads-rust epic, child story beads, acceptance criteria, quality gates, and dependency links for ralph-tui.

faq.question: Does it require beads-rust?
faq.answer: Yes. It is written for the br CLI from beads-rust, not the original bd command.

faq.question: Can it work from pasted PRD text?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use a PRD file or pasted markdown text as the source material.

faq.question: How does it handle quality gates?
faq.answer: It extracts project validation steps from the PRD and appends them to relevant bead acceptance criteria.

faq.question: Will it choose task dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. It orders foundational work first and links later stories to their blockers.

faq.question: What should users review before running commands?
faq.answer: Users should review generated descriptions, dependency order, quality gates, and any sensitive PRD text.
